headline: The Engineering Distinction Between Passive Drape and Active Structural Lock: Why Suit Collars Gap and Shoulders Collapse During Forward Lean
description: This article demonstrates that structural failure in suits, such as collar gap and shoulder collapse during forward lean, is not an unavoidable physical law but a specific consequence of traditional full canvas engineering. It introduces AETERNAL's Full Canvas Gravity Matrix as an alternative that uses active stress routing to maintain dynamic rigidity.
keywords: Full Canvas Gravity Matrix, Independent Tension Vectors, Q-Matrix, Dynamic Compensation Matrix, Omega Path Enforcement, Stress Fatigue, Shadow Pooling, suit engineering, dynamic fit, active structural lock
